## Featured connection {#featured .mm-section-title}

::: mm-feature
<p class="mm-type">

Research synthesis · Dissertation Focus

</p>

## What does a healthy mussel look like?

A *successful* mussel is one whose physiology supports its ability to
survive, grow, reproduce, and respond to environmental change. This is a
place to trace the connections that impact that physiology across
biological scales.

**What we know:** Physiological endpoints capture different aspects of
an organism's response.

**Why it matters:** Translating cellular changes into ecological meaning
requires attention to context, timescale, and organism-level function.

**What I'm connecting it to:** My research on biomarker responses, DNA
methylation, and the development of more integrative measures of mussel
health.

<p class="mm-meta">

Working feature — full post I get here.

</p>
:::
